Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality mobile loading/splash screen concept for the existing Sobrita app, with clear hierarchy, intentional imagery and generous purposeful spacing. Output one single flat mobile app content screen, target logical viewport 390 x 844, portrait 390:844 aspect ratio, render high-resolution and crisp. No phone bezel, frame, notch, device shadow, rounded device mask, status bar, clock, signal, battery, home indicator, browser chrome, concept labels, option numbers, collage, or multiple screens.
User brief: warm cream minimal launch screen showing ALL TWELVE existing animal companions together, Michi central and every other friend recognizable, upper Sobrita wordmark with breathing room, small three square loading dots beneath the ensemble. Preserve the app's pixel-art aesthetic. The attached reference image is a labeled 4-by-3 contact sheet showing all twelve actual character designs. Each cell corresponds to one animal in the roster below. This is an identity reference, NOT a layout to copy. Do not copy the grid, labels, cell backgrounds, or multiple poodle poses. Use only ONE poodle based on its large sitting pose. All 12 identities are present in this reference. MANDATORY CAST, exactly one of each, exactly twelve animals total; no duplicates, no extra species and no omissions:
1 Michi — dark navy kitten, one upright ear and one folded ear, three cream forehead stripes, amber eyes, cream muzzle/chest/paws/tail tip.
2 Miru — caramel-brown curly poodle, floppy curly ears, cream muzzle/chest/paws.
3 Yoshi — gray schnauzer, bright BLUE eyes, fluffy cream eyebrows and large cream beard.
4 Cookie — compact BLACK AND WHITE guinea pig, broad white central face stripe, short round ears and tiny pink paws. NOT a brown hamster.
5 Tranqui — warm chestnut capybara, rounded little ears, broad rectangular muzzle.
6 Lana — ivory fluffy alpaca, long neck, upright pointed ears, brown eyes.
7 Bandi — gray raccoon, dark eye mask and thick ringed tail.
8 Pico — brown platypus, distinctive broad gray duck bill, flat brown tail and webbed feet.
9 Bunny — gray-and-white rabbit, very long upright ears, white blaze and chest.
10 Penguin — navy-and-white penguin with GOLD YELLOW eyebrow tufts, orange beak and feet.
11 Quokka — smiling golden-brown quokka, round ears, dark paws, warm cream cheeks.
12 Happy — snowy white Maltese dog, long silky floppy ears, TOPKNOT tied with teal band, dark eyes, fluffy white tail.
All twelve wear their reference teal collar and square golden charm. Preserve distinctive silhouettes, color patterns and faces. Use coherent rich pixel art matching the real assets: fine stepped edges, soft limited pixel shading, expressive friendly eyes, not smooth vector art, not photorealism, not 3D.
Background flat warm cream #F6EFE0 with almost imperceptible paper texture. Ink #202848 navy, accent #0E7A72 teal, loading inactive #E7DDC8 beige. No unnecessary objects, room scenery, coins, props, clothing, furniture, cards, panels, frames, shadows except subtle grounding under animals. Passive loading screen: no actions, navigation, tabs, metrics, badges, percentages or progress estimates.
Exact visible text ONLY: "Sobrita" in large bold dark navy Pixelify Sans-style pixel lettering, and "불러오는 중…" in understated legible 14px Korean pixel typography. Three small square loading dots: one teal, two beige. Avoid crowding, keep all heads, ears, paws and tails unclipped within safe margins. Every face should remain distinguishable on a mobile screen. Do not stretch proportions.
Direction name (internal only, not printed): "Our little family portrait".
Composition: Calm centered classical ensemble portrait. Wordmark centered around y 215, 40px logical type, with ample plain cream above and beneath. Group occupies x 25..365 and y 355..645. Arrange twelve companions in THREE staggered shallow rows of FOUR animals, as a naturally gathered family rather than a grid. Back row left to right: Lana alpaca, Bunny rabbit, Tranqui capybara, Bandi raccoon. Middle row left to right: Yoshi schnauzer, Miru poodle, Quokka, Penguin. Front row left to right: Cookie guinea pig, Michi kitten (central focal point slightly larger), Happy Maltese, Pico platypus. Each animal occurs once. Stagger the rows horizontally so no face is obscured; taller friends at back, smaller at front, only lower bodies may gently overlap. Friendly subtle head tilts. No rigid tiles, dividers or separate podiums. Group feels cohesive, soft semicircular outer silhouette, detailed but uncluttered. At y 714 place centered three square dots; at y 746 exact text "불러오는 중…". Bottom remains airy. Count twelve clearly visible distinct faces before finalizing.

Direction name (internal only, never printed): "Friends in a gentle crescent".
Composition: More airy and graphic than a family photo. Center exact word "Sobrita" at y 245 in 39px navy pixel type, lots of quiet cream above. Characters form a compact wide HOLLOW CRESCENT gathering across x 22..368, y 410..630: two gracefully curved staggered ranks with open breathing space above their center. Small animals, smaller in scale than the prior family portrait, most of screen remains clean cream. Outer/back arc has SEVEN animals left to right: tall Lana alpaca at far left, Bunny rabbit, Tranqui capybara, Bandi raccoon, Yoshi schnauzer, Miru poodle, Penguin at far right. Inner/front arc has FIVE smaller animals left to right: Cookie guinea pig, Quokka, Michi cat at the LOWEST CENTER, Happy Maltese, Pico platypus. These form a gentle shallow U-shaped smile, not a rectangular lineup, not a wreath around text, not a grid. The animals angle gently toward central Michi while all faces remain visible to viewer. Michi subtly raises one paw to welcome the viewer. Small bodies and tails carefully distinct, ears complete, balanced spacing, NO creature duplicated or omitted. Only a very light shared beige crescent grounding shadow, no stage, no props, no greenery or stars. All 12 characters recognizable with matching teal collars and golden charms.
Separate the assembly from loading: three tiny centered square dots at y 700, exact Korean "불러오는 중…" at y 730. Prioritize whitespace and charming subtle interactions, not big illustration density. Exactly twelve clear faces.

Composition: An elegant playful editorial splash with big clean cream negative space. Center "Sobrita" at y 230, logical font size 40px, crisp dark navy pixel lettering. Under the wordmark leave at least 95px of clean whitespace. The main artwork shows exactly 12 HEAD-AND-UPPER-BODY character portraits with small front paws, peeking over TWO subtle horizontal cream paper ledges/waves. This intentional chest-up cropping is the defining concept and overrides the full-body rule; heads and ears NEVER clipped. No boxes, shelves, furniture, windows, panels or frame; the ledges are very simple same-cream paper edges with a single fine muted beige pixel line and ultra-subtle shading that separate the ranks.
Back/top rank around y 440..525, six characters from left to right: Lana alpaca, Bunny rabbit, Tranqui capybara, Bandi raccoon, Penguin, Quokka. Let the alpaca long neck, rabbit ears and penguin golden tufts break the top silhouette naturally.
Front/lower rank around y 560..655, six characters from left to right: Miru poodle, Yoshi schnauzer with blue eyes, Cookie black-and-white guinea pig, Michi navy kitten, Happy white Maltese with teal topknot, Pico platypus. Michi has a gentle head tilt and raised paw toward the viewer. All other animals lightly rest tiny front paws or flippers over their own paper edge. Arrange the characters with slight stagger and varying gentle head tilts, expressive but tidy. All 12 are equally legible, each head roughly 48 logical pixels wide with 6px separation and 20px outside margins. Bodies mostly hidden makes the composition lighter than a full-body group, each face has enough cream space to breathe. No extra animals and no duplicates.
Three tiny square loading dots centered y 724; exact Korean "불러오는 중…" at y 755. No other words. Warm cream full-screen, sparse refined art, delightful friendly greetings. Count the top six and bottom six to verify all twelve.
